$comment: Ownership registry for song IDs in ilyrium-shots/. Claim a prefix and an ID range BEFORE scaffolding a project. Enforced by song_id_registry.py. Created 2026-09-01 after New Harnomy and KING SIZE were found sharing the NH- prefix in one flat shots/ directory.
rules: A song ID is owned by exactly one project, for the life of the repo.
Never re-prefix or renumber an ID that already has ledger history - the provenance chain is keyed on it.
New projects claim an unused prefix here first, then scaffold.
NH- is reserved for NEW HARNOMY, U.S.A. except for the legacy claims recorded below.

NH.title: NEW HARNOMY, U.S.A.
NH.scheme: act-based: NH-S1nn (Act I) / NH-S2nn (Act II) / NH-S3nn (Act III), nn = global number 01-48
NH.note: Two-digit NH-S0n IDs are NOT New Harnomy's - see legacy_claims.

KS.title: KING SIZE (young Stripe music video)
KS.note: Use KS- for all NEW King Size work. The existing NH-S05 render set keeps its ID permanently - it has 177 ledger entries and a verified chain.

NH-S03.note: Early render smoke test on the now-terminated instance i-030994c5371ee5de9. Do not reuse this ID. Safe to archive once someone confirms it is not referenced by a delivered cut.

NH-S05.note: KING SIZE was forced onto the NH- prefix because shot_spec.schema.json hardcoded ^NH-S[0-9]{2,}$ until 2026-09-01. The ID is load-bearing: it appears in the ledger chain, contact sheets, concat lists and PowerShell runners. It stays. New King Size work uses KS-.
